question: A plane wavefront travels from medium $A$ to medium $B$. The refracted ray bends away from the normal. Compare the speeds of light in the two media and justify your answer.

options.A: Since the ray bends away from the normal, $v_B<v_A$.
options.B: The speeds are equal because a refracted ray cannot bend away from the normal.
options.C: Bending away means $r>i$. Therefore $\dfrac{\sin i}{\sin r}<1$. From $\dfrac{\sin i}{\sin r}=\dfrac{v_A}{v_B}$, it follows that $v_A<v_B$; light travels faster in medium $B$.
options.D: The ray bends away from the normal only when the wavelength in medium $B$ is zero.
